Subject: Supplier intake & payment cadence question (Clearsail)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the product demo last week. As we start vendor onboarding with Procurement, a couple of items came up that I wanted to clarify before we submit the intake form.

1) Our standard is Net 60 but we are open to Net 30 for early-stage partners. For Redwood, can you confirm if you offer a staged milestone billing option (invoice on completion of Milestone 1 / Milestone 2) rather than a single monthly invoice?

2) We also have an early-settlement program that can remit earlier for a small fee. Would Redwood participate in a 14-day accelerated remit for the first milestone while we finalize PO routing?

I attached our supplier intake PDF and a draft SOW so you can see how the milestones are defined. If you can send the PO workflow and the earliest invoice-cutoff we can pass that to our finance team.

Attachments: [Clearsail_Supplier_Intake.pdf (PDF, 412KB)], [SOW_v0.3.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]

Appreciate a quick read — our procurement kickoff is 12/07.

Best,
Elena Morales

Elena —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear milestone breakdown in the SOW. Short answers up front: yes, we can support milestone-based invoicing, and we can pilot an accelerated remit option for the first milestone subject to a couple operational checks.

Operational items to confirm from our side:
- PO and invoice routing: We need the exact PO number and the remit-to address when you submit the supplier intake. Our AP team requires PO to be associated with the first milestone invoice for automated routing.
- Invoice cutoff: For milestone invoicing, our standard cutoff for same-week payment is invoices received by 11:59pm PT on Friday. If you need the 14-day accelerated remit, we typically require: a signed acceptance for the milestone, invoice submitted via our portal, and a one-time early-pay request form.
- Fees: The early-settlement fee is a small percentage (we'll propose 1.5% for a 14-day remit on milestone 1). Marissa, can you confirm the fee tier and process? Karthik — can you confirm whether PO gating will block milestone invoices if the PO is pending?

Proposed short next steps:
1) Elena: Submit the supplier intake with the desired PO value and indicate milestone billing.
2) Marissa: I'll loop you into the portal invite and the request form flow so Clearsail can complete the early-pay opt-in.
3) Karthik: Once PO is visible in our system, can we prioritize a one-off manual release for the first milestone to hit the accelerated remit pilot?

If that works, we can include the DocuSign link for the early-pay addendum and have our AP hold the first milestone for a 14-day accelerated payout.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
